# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated for this report.

- [`architecture-diagram.md`](./architecture-diagram.md) - Application architecture and component interaction diagrams.
- [`dependency-map.md`](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency categories, versions, and compatibility notes.
- [`api-service-contracts.md`](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service communication patterns and API/contract inventory.
- [`data-architecture.md`](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity relationships, and data sensitivity analysis.
- [`configuration-inventory.md`](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime settings, and secret handling inventory.
- [`business-workflows.md`](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflow analysis and sequence documentation.
